cohort: Women who delivered between July and October 2021 at a large tertiary medical center
finding: Receiving a SARS-CoV-2 booster dose during pregnancy was not associated with adverse obstetrical outcomes compared to unvaccinated or twice-vaccinated women, although higher rates of postpartum hemorrhage were observed.
